value.scope: Windows local synthetic fixture, not external/full product/release acceptance

value.harnessMeaning: Exact current allowlisted harness byte digests match the retained run evidence; no new regression was executed.

criteria.rationale: Approved MR/DS full-SHA genesis is pinned exactly; chain and SOURCE:candidate identities are checked. Real project ledger remains empty and frozen locks unchanged.

criteria.originalCriterion: Code diff is based on complete baseline and candidate SHAs.
criteria.rationale: Full commit objects drive Git name-status/numstat/tree reads; post-candidate dirty/untracked bytes are excluded. Include rebuilds the proposal before writing.

criteria.originalCriterion: Functional diff/review is based on complete SHAs.
criteria.rationale: Independent exact-object candidate-functional-source-snapshot retains all forty F rows, source ownership, full baseline/candidate SHA, tree/object metadata and nested digests. Include rebuilds and persists it exactly. Selected repository is observed; other repositories remain lock-only-not-observed. This is source review, NOT complete behavior or equivalence.

criteria.originalCriterion: Changed files are listed before inclusion.
criteria.rationale: Real isolated Git candidate lists every changed file before explicit approval, including nested add, rename, binary and unknown; DS also exercises add/change/delete.

criteria.originalCriterion: Rename, binary, unusual paths, and line statistics are preserved without fabrication.
criteria.rationale: NUL streams preserve old/new rename paths and spaces; binary line counts stay null. Tab parser coverage is synthetic, not a real Windows tab filename.

criteria.originalCriterion: Affected F/R/T are listed before inclusion and drive the inclusion workflow.
criteria.rationale: Frozen scope validates reviewer-added F/R/T before selection. One effectiveImpact merges mechanical and reviewer additions, binds approval reviews, and persists in ledger/release. Unknown-only F/R/T, mixed and illegal-ID branches are exercised. Catalog is intentionally bounded, not all R/T acceptance.

criteria.originalCriterion: Unknown files remain visible and are not silently converted to no impact or verified behavior.
criteria.rationale: Every diff row requires a reason/disposition; unknowns explicitly choose no-frt-impact or frt-impact-confirmed. No automatic verified behavior or silent unknown removal.

criteria.originalCriterion: Registered source-directory filtering and F mapping use consistent real path boundaries.
criteria.rationale: Registered path boundaries cover directory descendants and incoming renames while refusing sibling prefixes. Snapshot objects must stay within each registration.

criteria.originalCriterion: Proposal Markdown accurately describes directory-descendant matching.
criteria.rationale: Generated Markdown describes registered file/directory-descendant matching and separately explains candidate source snapshot coverage and non-behavior boundary.

criteria.originalCriterion: Interface/data migration and risk review occur before inclusion.
criteria.rationale: Interface/data migration review requires a plan or reasoned none; all five risks require explicit disposition. DS additionally binds candidate SOURCE/vendor before/after manifest. Actual production migration is not established.

criteria.originalCriterion: A non-empty target inclusion version is required and associated with the increment.
criteria.rationale: Non-empty semantic targetVersion is required and associated with candidate, ledger and release comparison; missing version refuses writes.

criteria.originalCriterion: Explicit inclusion precedes controlled baseline, inventory, and ledger updates.
criteria.rationale: Explicit candidate-bound approval precedes controlled publication. MR leaves DS bytes unchanged. DS stages exact raw blobs and binds SOURCE/vendor/locks in one exclusive-marker transaction. Six caught partial publications and seven hard process exits restore original bytes through explicit recovery. Main baseline is not adopted.

criteria.originalCriterion: After explicit inclusion, update records and really run the candidate-bound affected regressions; failure must not become passed.
criteria.rationale: Checked-in allowlisted harnesses execute real candidate router/CLI/DS behavior from an isolated tree verified file-by-file against raw Git blobs. Candidate-only behavior faults fail; dirty governance bytes do not replace candidate. Exit/count/log/hash/candidate/harness bindings are checked and failed regression rolls back. Bounded regressions are not full product tests.

criteria.originalCriterion: Release output compares included increments, not only README or package version.
criteria.rationale: Empty and isolated nonempty included-increment ledger comparisons are exercised; candidate, target version, effective impact and regressions appear in release output. Real current F write/check receipts passed before unified run. General worktree preview remains distinct from candidate snapshot.

criteria.originalCriterion: Automatic HEAD tracking cannot silently change acceptance scope.
criteria.rationale: HEAD, branches and short SHAs are refused. No upstream fetch/adoption is inferred; inventory HEAD equality is a guard, not automatic tracking. Real baseline/scope remains frozen.

criteriaReview.historyBoundary: Original review is immutable and predates full3. Its retained-artifact/write-fault not_run caveats are superseded only by the exact full3 evidence here; full current-source unified gate is still pending.

transactionCoverage.faultMechanism: Temporary-path EEXIST collision in isolated child-process fixture only; production include/recover assertions unchanged.
transactionCoverage.recovery: Marker-bound recovery restores original vendor/SOURCE/lock bytes; stale marker and unrelated bytes rejected; SOURCE/vendor publication sides bound independently.
